description: This file defines the Role entity class for the application's domain model, representing user roles such as ADMIN, AGENT, and CUSTOMER. It includes annotations for ORM mapping using JPA, field definitions, constructors, and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Entity class representing application roles with fields for ID, name, description, creation timestamp, and associated users.

methods.name: Role(String name)
methods.description: Constructor initializing Role with a specific name.

methods.name: getName()
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the role.

methods.name: getCreatedAt()
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the role was created.

methods.name: getUsers()
methods.description: Returns the set of users associated with this role.

methods.name: setUsers(Set<User> users)
methods.description: Sets the collection of users associated with this role.
